purpose: Freeze law1 and law2, then add independent QUINELLA laws using discovery years only.

fixed_laws.definition: Apply frozen V2 race pick MODEL_TOP15 + rank_upgrade>=5 + max1, then keep rank_upgrade 15-24 and field_size 15-16.
Among model_rank<=15 and rank_upgrade>=10, keep model_rank 1-3 and select max1 ticket per race using frozen candidate sort.

candidate_universe: Same finite grid as L2_MARKET_GAP_LAW_ARENA_V1; LAW1 and LAW2 aliases excluded.
selection_objective: At each step, among eligible candidates choose highest incremental discovery profit; tie-break by incremental max-win-removed ROI, minimum yearly ROI, unique ticket count, then candidate_id. Recompute uniqueness against the enlarged portfolio after each addition.
reporting: pooled incremental ROI and max-win-removed ROI
2025 confirmation for each selected law and cumulative portfolio
pairwise overlap matrix among selected laws
